design_description: A bold, expressive design for Unicorns Don't Give a Fuck, built around an elegant cream base with flowing pink and metallic-gold graphics. Sweeping flame-like ribbons rise diagonally from the lower hem, creating movement while giving the jersey a distinctive, almost mythical visual identity. The asymmetric composition keeps the upper body clean while small star accents add energy and connect naturally with the unicorn-inspired aesthetic. Pink collar and sleeve trim frame the design, while gold branding and detailing introduce a more premium, refined contrast. Overall, the jersey feels playful, rebellious, and confident, combining the team's irreverent identity with a surprisingly elegant execution.
